summary.text: Kurt Vail represents the 52nd District, which includes Somers, Stafford, Union and Woodstock, and was re-elected to a sixth term in November 2024.

paragraphs.text: Before serving in the General Assembly he was a member of the Stafford School Board, the Stafford Downtown Revitalization Committee and its Recreation Commission.
He has served on the Stafford Youth Football board since 2006 and was its president from 2007 to 2009.
